drivers.text: FY2023–FY2025 revenue rose from 6496 to 12579 to 16635 USDmm; 2026 Q3 revenue was 8546 USDmm versus 4341 USDmm a year earlier, and nine-month revenue was 21039 USDmm versus 11255 USDmm. The forecast starts below the latest reported growth and moderates over the horizon.
2026 nine-month operating income was 6584 USDmm versus 1851 USDmm in the prior-year period, supporting continued growth while the revenue growth assumption tapers.

FY2023–FY2025 revenue was 10863, 9649, and 14550 USDmm; 2026 Q3 revenue was 3722 USDmm versus 4048 USDmm a year earlier, while nine-month revenue was 11168 USDmm versus 10610 USDmm. The moderate forecast reflects the mixed annual and current-period record.
Nine-month operating income was 1730 USDmm versus 2130 USDmm in the prior-year period, a reason to keep forecast growth below the mandate ceiling.

FY2023–FY2025 revenue was 5321, 3557, and 3454 USDmm; 2026 Q3 revenue was 1109 USDmm versus 857 USDmm a year earlier, and nine-month revenue was 2959 USDmm versus 2504 USDmm. The forecast assumes modest growth and gradual moderation given the longer-term decline and recent recovery.
Nine-month operating income was 1177 USDmm versus 886 USDmm in the prior-year period, supporting a modest recovery assumption.
